components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true

          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:

          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:

          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:

          type: string

          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:

          maxLength: 20

        registrationDate:

## Summary

I implemented the household-duplicate rejection for `POST /api/owners` following the project's OfficeFloor function-injection conventions.

**The rule:** creating an owner is rejected with **409** when another owner already has the same `lastName` **and** `address` (compared case-insensitively, with collapsed whitespace) — unless the request sets `sharesHousehold: true`.

**Changes:**

1. **`openapi.yml`** — added a request-only `sharesHousehold` boolean to the `OwnerFields` schema so the generated `OwnerFieldsDto` exposes `getSharesHousehold()`. It isn't a field on the `Owner` entity, so it's never persisted or returned.

3. **`DuplicateHouseholdException.java`** — checked exception (`extends Exception`) so it surfaces in the `throws` clause.

4. **`DuplicateHouseholdExceptionHandler.java`** + its escalation YAML — responds `409 Conflict`, matching the shape of the existing duplicate-telephone handler.

5. **`owners.POST.yml`** — wired `ensureUniqueHousehold` into the pipeline right after `ensureUniqueTelephone`.
